newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Chung Hwa says U.S. spinoff plan ongoing.
newsitem.headline: Chung Hwa says U.S. spinoff plan ongoing.

text.p: Chung Hwa Development Holdings Ltd said on Friday it was still in discussions on a proposed public offering of shares of a subsidiary on a U.S. stock exchange or over-the-counter market.
It said no terms had been finalised.
The packaging company said discussions were in a preliminary stage and the terms and conditions had not been finalised.
"No application has been made to any U.S. stock exchange or U.S. over-the-counter market," it said in the statement.
The company said the proposed listing would be made by means of a prospectus.
In March, Chung Hwa said it intended to spinoff its packaging products distributing unit Leading Edge Packaging Holdings Ltd in the United States.
Chung Hwa shares were unchanged at HK$1.30 in early trade.
